# BBK TypeScript/JavaScript profile boundaries

## The profile may

- inspect repository-declared TS/JS configuration and source signals;
- identify language, runtime, package, module and tooling modes;
- select relevant procedure and focused review packs;
- propose proportional gate recipes;
- produce a content-addressed profile lock;
- define evidence and handoff expectations;
- expose resolver tools through OMP.

## The profile may not

- grant tools, filesystem scope, network access, credentials, package installation, publication, deployment, migration or destructive effects;
- install or update Node, Bun, Deno, TypeScript, package managers, linters, bundlers, test runners, browsers or dependencies;
- execute install lifecycle scripts or alter a lockfile silently;
- replace repository-owned commands, module policy, runtime support, strictness or release policy;
- broaden a work unit or lower a BBK assurance contract;
- mark an assertion passed, close a finding, accept risk or authorize release;
- claim hostile-code sandboxing or unsupported runtime compatibility;
- turn temporary BBK records into official Blueprint state.

## Worker and validator boundary

Workers receive `bbk-tsjs`, `tsjs-development-practices`, exact scope and planned gates. They normally do not receive the focused prompt that later judges the candidate.

Validators receive one exact candidate, assigned assertions, applicable deterministic receipts and read-only subject access. Additional validators require disjoint assertion ownership or a genuinely complementary method.

## Repository authority

Adding a dependency, changing a package manager, regenerating a lockfile, enabling broad strictness, changing module format, adding dual publication, changing browser/runtime support, or adding a CI gate is a project decision and effect—not an automatic profile action.

## Maturity boundary

`comprehensive-alpha` means the pack has broad procedure, resolver, fixture and packaging coverage. It does not mean every framework, runtime, package manager, browser or deployment form has been qualified. See `references/support-matrix.md`.

## Alpha.4 structure boundary

The profile may project generic structure and slice objects, compare fixed consequential shape with an exact candidate and return review findings. It may not accept or revise the generic object, freeze every private helper, invent missing work scope, execute planned gates, grant effects, repair the candidate, or treat its projection as a second source of truth.
